title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a single plant has source-written seasonal part succession
summary: Seek a complete historical plant entry that explicitly orders flowering, fruit or seed, and collection of a named part for the same plant, with a second independently owned entry whose order or harvest condition differs. Freeze the written temporal and part relations before target inspection. A whole reading of an admitted Herbal paragraph would need to preserve the same plant across stages and place the contrasted harvest condition correctly; a static parts list or generic seasonal gloss would not suffice. No eligible pair or target span is asserted. This does not reopen the closed same-plant root route without its required new relation.

design.mechanism: source-owned temporal succession binds changing plant parts to one continuing plant owner
design.unit: two complete independently identified historical entries and complete already admitted Herbal paragraphs
design.contrast: ordered same-plant phenology with a different harvest condition versus static part inventory
design.prediction: one predeclared whole reading retains plant identity while recovering source-specific part order and harvest condition; no independent owner or target capacity means no semantic test
